edges.reason: mint calls _presaleMint when isPresale() is true
mint calls _publicMint when isPubsale() is true
mint branches on the isPresale view result
mint branches on the isPubsale view result
isPresale compares block.timestamp against salePlans.startTime to enable the phase
isPubsale compares block.timestamp against salePlans.startTime + 2 days
whenPresale modifier gates _presaleMint execution on block.timestamp
whenPublicSale modifier gates _publicMint execution on block.timestamp
whitelists[msg.sender] controls whether the caller may presale mint
msg.sender is the recipient of publicly minted tokens
_presaleMint safe-mints tokens to the caller
_publicMint safe-mints tokens to the caller
_presaleMint increments presaleCount and reads it for allocation limits
_publicMint increments pubsaleCount after each mint
_presaleMint reads salePlans prices, limits and allocations
_publicMint reads salePlans prices, limits and allocations
_publicMint bounds minting by MAX_SUPPLY_COUNT
_presaleMint forwards surplus ETH to the caller after minting state changes
_publicMint forwards surplus ETH to the caller after minting state changes
